'''Hypotria''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a deep-cover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[R2z-DL's operative|operative]] and their [[R2z Starship Maintenance Droid|astromech droid]], [[R2z-DL]], were posted on Hypotria, where the latter, posing as a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]], was stealing valuable data off [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arriving for repairs and then placing it in the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] vessels.

At one point, the [[Laboi]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Qa'till]], whose employees [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Rebel operative, assumed control over the planet's starship maintenance operations. R2z-DL, however, continued his Alliance assignment, eventually passing on information that facilitated the [[Liberation of Vilosoria|liberation]] of the planet [[Vilosoria]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] control.

==Description==
Hypotria was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CRO" /> located in the [[Hypotria system/Legends|Hypotria system]], a part of the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
===Repairs and espionage===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a deep-cover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[R2z-DL's operative|operative]] was posted on Hypotria. Their [[R2z Starship Maintenance Droid]], [[R2z-DL]], who was posing as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] operating out of a [[R2z-DL's repair shop|repair shop]], was tasked with stealing data from ships arriving for repairs and then placing that information in the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of vessels carrying special Alliance codes&mdash;with very few Rebel agents encountering the [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]] personally. At one point, however, employees of<ref name="CRO" /> the murderous<ref name="CSWE Qa'till">{{CSWECite|III|54|Qa'till}}</ref> [[Laboi]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Qa'till]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the operative.<ref name="CRO" />

Qa'till ultimately consolidated and gained control over all of Hypotria's starship maintenance operations. R2z-DL, who continued his assignment for the Alliance<ref name="CRO" />&mdash;and, in doing so, operated behind enemy lines<ref name="CSWE R2z-DL">{{CSWECite|III|70|R2Z-DL (Toozy)}}</ref>&mdash;used the changing situation to his advantage. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] created [[Programmer/Legends|programs]] that monitored any incoming starships and made it so that the vessels that were most likely to carry useful information aboard were routed to his repair shop. Occasionally, the mechanical [[Spy/Legends|spy]] also initiated false repair requests so that he could work on ships with especially high potential as sources of valuable information.<ref name="CRO" />

===A vital data packet===
[[File:Lifh_sector.jpg|thumb|right|250px|R2z-DL's espionage work on Hypotria, in the Bortele sector, influenced events in the neighboring Lifh sector.]]
At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], R2z-DL, who was tracking the movements of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] near<ref name="CSWE R2z-DL" /> the neighboring<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector's]]<ref name="EAOC Vilosoria">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vilosoria system/Legends|Vilosoria system]]</ref> planet [[Vilosoria]], obtained<ref name="CRO" /> Imperial codes,<ref name="CSWE Fireclaw">{{CSWECite|I|274|''Fireclaw''}}</ref> information about the Empire's supply lines in the Lifh [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the patrol routes of the Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Fireclaw]]'', reports on malfunctions in that [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|vessel's]] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]], and a description of the seasonal physiological cycles underwent by Vilosoria's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Vilosorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The droid hid all of that information in a data packet aboard the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] of the Alliance [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Koedi Raef]], who discovered it while traveling through the Lifh sector. The information ultimately facilitated the [[Liberation of Vilosoria|liberation]] of Vilosoria from Imperial control.<ref name="CRO" />

Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] later noted R2z-DL's posting on Hypotria in an entry dedicated to the droid that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" /> Qa'till's control over the planet's starship maintenance services continued into the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="CSWE Qa'till" /> which was [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|formed]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hypotria was created by [[Chuck Truett]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, it was illustrated by [[Doug Shuler]].<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hypotria [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
